response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering skills across multiple languages (C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript) and systems (Linux, distributed systems, geospatial data). However, his experience is heavily skewed toward web/mobile development and scripting languages (Node.js, TypeScript), with limited direct exposure to modern C++ for routing/navigation pipelines or high-performance geospatial processing. His work on GISCollective is relevant but not at the scale or complexity required for this role.
strengths: Proven expertise in system design and distributed systems (high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby)
Strong background in geospatial data platforms (GISCollective, Green Map)
Demonstrated ability to learn new languages/tools quickly (e.g., Rust alternatives in his work)
concerns: Limited direct experience with modern C++ for performance-critical routing/tiling pipelines
No explicit mention of navigation systems or routing algorithm optimization
Most recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, which doesn't align closely with the C++/Rust requirement
